full_judgment: 25. Learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that the defendants could not produce any document showing their settlement from Rezia Khatun before the trial court, as such, SA record has no basis. From perusal of exhibit-Umo-3, it appears that Appeal Officer in his judgment observed that Azahar Ali Mridha claimed that he obtained pattan from Rezia Khatun before the SAT Act came into force and he executed a kabuliyat before delivery of possession and after obtaining settlement he constructed homestead thereon and living with his family members, but Azahar Ali Mridha could not file kabuliyat before the Settlement Officer and Appeal Officer, however, he produced rent receipts showing payment of rent to Rezia Khatun and after SAT Act came into force he regularly made payment of rents to the government.
